name: Homepage

fields.label: Service groups and widgets
fields.description: Native Homepage services.yaml array. Includes groups, app links, widgets, descriptions, icons, status checks and per-service options. Keep secrets in HOMEPAGE_VAR_ environment variables.

warnings: Homepage has no built-in authentication. Protect it with an authenticated reverse proxy.
Widget credentials belong in HOMEPAGE_VAR_ environment variables, referenced from YAML. Do not put reusable tokens in public links.
